title: Early Vedic polity: assemblies, wars and rivers

boxes.title: Assemblies: added detail
items: Mentions in Rig Veda: Vidatha 122, ==**Samiti 9, Sabha 8**==
Atharvaveda: Sabha called =="**narishta**"==; women in Samiti
Later Vedic: Sabha + Samiti limited to **nobles and Brahmanas**
Assemblies with elective traces = early **"democratic"** elements

boxes.title: Officials & justice
items: Gramani also ==military leader of the grama==
==No officers for justice==: disputes by community consensus

cards.title: Seven rivers
lines: Sindhu, Vitasta, Asikni, Parushni, Vipas, Sutudri, Sarasvati

cards.title: Extent
lines: E. Afghanistan, **NWFP**, Punjab, Haryana, W. UP fringes

boxes.title: Later Vedic & AP
items: Rig Veda = **only source** for the period
AP: "Andhra" first in ==**Aitareya Brahmana**== (Sunahshepa), not Rig Veda

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: UPSC 2026: only ==**Parushni-Ravi**== correct; **Yavyavati** is not the Beas
